<thought>Search the template catalog using the correct bond format: a C‑C single bond formed (6-6) and a C‑O single bond broken (6-8). The functional groups lost in the forward reaction are ketones and C‑C triple bonds, so we specify those as formed in the retrosynthetic direction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"]
}</action_input>
